canonical_purpose: Optimize retrieval configuration against downstream answer and task success instead of treating ANN recall as the final objective.
intended_outcome: A reviewer or operator can compare retrieval policies on labeled downstream outcomes, reject under-evidenced changes, and select a materially better policy through a reproducible installable tool.
deployment_reason: Local/reference retrieval evaluation tool; an always-on deployment is not required for the canonical outcome.
truth_boundary: Independent local/reference system. Repository-owned labeled data is synthetic reference evidence; no Pinecone affiliation, proprietary integration, production deployment, customer impact, or production-quality claim is made.
receipt_binding: This receipt binds terminal status to the exact verified source SHA and successful workflow run above. The receipt-only commit must itself retain green verification before merge.
